The '''lower level troop barracks''' were located in [[Sector N-One/Legends|Sector N-One]] aboard the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]]. They were destroyed along with the rest of the Death Star during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].
